purpose: analyst targets + PER for watchlist analytics view (phase 1)
collectionMethod: Direct WebFetch to every candidate source (stockanalysis.com, finance.yahoo.com, TipRanks, MarketBeat, Zacks, WSJ, Benzinga, CNN Markets, MarketScreener, GuruFocus, Macrotrends, Investing.com, SimplyWall.st) was blocked by the session's egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED on every finance domain tested). All figures below were therefore obtained via WebSearch using site-restricted queries (e.g. 'site:stockanalysis.com TICKER forecast price target analysts'), which the search backend was able to answer with synthesized snippets naming the source explicitly. Numbers are recorded as returned in those snippets, not reconciled. Where a source's snippet stated a percent-upside/downside instead of a literal price, the implied current price was back-calculated from that percentage (noted per field as 'derived').
